report_name: Dassault Systèmes Patches Critical RCE in 3DEXPERIENCE Platform

vulnerabilities.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data in 3DEXPERIENCE Station Launcher App
vulnerabilities.description: A critical "Deserialization of Untrusted Data" vulnerability in the Station Launcher App component of the Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE platform could allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution. The flaw affects releases R2023x through R2026x.

indicators.name: Suspicious Child Process of 3DEXPERIENCE Service
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Child Process of 3DEXPERIENCE Service
id: d2c1b0a9-3e4d-4f5a-8b6c-7d8e9f0a1b2c
status: experimental
description: Detects the main 3DEXPERIENCE platform service spawning a command-line interpreter, which could indicate successful remote code execution via a deserialization vulnerability.
references:
  - https://www.3ds.com/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-29
tags:
  - attack.t1059
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\3DEXPERIENCE_Service.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the main 3DEXPERIENCE platform service spawning a command-line interpreter (cmd.exe, powershell.exe), which could indicate successful remote code execution as described in the hunting hints.
